name: Shokushu no Naedoko ni Natta Onna-tachi
original_name: 触手の苗床になった女達
source:
One night at a party, Marie takes Scarlett and Lian to see the World Tree underground. There, due to Marie's carelessness, the three are captured by the World Tree. They are violated by tentacles, and a special semen is poured into their wombs one after another. Soon, their greatly swollen bellies are filled with countless lives...

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150217030605/https://www.route2.co.jp/Trois/Products/MonsterPark2_FD/shop.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
某晚派对期间，玛丽带着斯嘉丽与莉安前往地下观赏世界树。谁知由于玛丽一时疏忽大意，三人不幸被世界树捕获。她们惨遭触手肆意侵犯，特殊的精液源源不断地注入她们的子宫。没过多久，三人高高隆起的肚腹里便孕育满了数不清的新生命……

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150217030605/https://www.route2.co.jp/Trois/Products/MonsterPark2_FD/shop.html]官方网站[/url]]
